Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City and County of San Francisco, October 5, 1933
sources.label: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, San Francisco Public Library (Internet Archive)

historical_record.description: Asked by Hiram W. Johnson among others to improve the park site at the northeast corner of Vallejo and Taylor Streets, the Board of Park Commissioners had no money for it and put a request for the funds into the next annual budget.
